meta.question: on CUB (final, seeds 1-3, K=29), does the MaskedKD student's last-block CLS attention concentrate from e25 to final, and do images whose attention concentrates more lose more masked-teacher signal?
meta.method: per image normalised entropy of the selection score and KL(full teacher || teacher on the 29 top-score patches) at e25 / e50 / final snapshots; within-image change e25 -> final averaged over seeds; Spearman with image bootstrap
meta.paper: Son et al. ECCV 2024 (MaskedKD); Abnar & Zuidema ACL 2020 (attention rollout); Darcet et al. ICLR 2024 (registers, attention artefacts); Hinton et al. 2015; Wah et al. 2011 (CUB)
